title: Ask, Listen and Respond in a Biology Conversation
objective: Students practice question forms, clarification, and polite repair when they do not understand.
outcomes: Request repetition or slower speech politely.
Answer with a complete but simple sentence.
Keep a conversation going for one minute.
activity: Ask a question, check what you heard and ask one more.
example: A lab partner asks, “What did you observe?” A useful answer is, “We observed that bacterial growth was higher at 30 degrees Celsius.”
